next.reason: §1989:A.2.41.4 RV2: 'The square root of the quotient obtained is then calculated. The returned value is the absolute value of this square root.' §2023:15.86.4 RV1 defines the result as '(FUNCTION SQRT (FUNCTION VARIANCE (argument-list)))' and §2023:15.84.4 RV4 gives SQRT, 'When native arithmetic is in effect', as 'the absolute value of the approximation of the square root of argument-1', the words of §1989:A.2.40.4 RV1. A 1985 program has no ARITHMETIC clause, so native arithmetic is in effect (§2023:11.9.5.2 GR4: 'it is as if the ARITHMETIC clause were specified with the NATIVE phrase'). RV-15.84.4-2 ('When standard-decimal arithmetic is in effect ... rounded to 34 digits') and RV-15.84.4-3 ('When standard-binary arithmetic is in effect ... rounded to 113 significant bits') are removed from 'to' (band-85 adjudication 2026-11-10): they govern modes no 1985 program can select and state no 1985 requirement.
